fields.label: Access token
fields.description: The company's WhatsApp access token. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

fields.label: Webhook signing secret
fields.description: The secret the provider signs its events with. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

fields.label: Number ID
fields.description: The provider's id for the company's WhatsApp number.

fields.label: WhatsApp business account ID
fields.description: The company's WhatsApp Business Account ID in Meta (SOS-INT-1).

fields.label: Webhook verify token
fields.description: The text Meta sends back when the webhook address is set up (SOS-INT-1). Stored encrypted and never shown again.

fields.label: WhatsApp number
fields.description: The number customers write to, with the country code.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Empty means Meta's Cloud API. The fake provider is for tests and works only on a site that allows tests.
